_comment: Example policy for JAMF_ENABLED=true deployments, checking Jamf-managed devices against a Jamf Pro Smart Group instead of (or alongside) Intune/Entra. Copy this to POLICY_RULES_FILE (default /config/policy.json) and edit. Certs need a `<URN_PREFIX>:jamf-serial:{{SERIALNUMBER}}` SAN URI (see README's 'Jamf Pro device lookup' section) - jamf_device_found/jamf_device_managed/jamf_compliant_group_member/jamf_last_contact_age_hours are only populated when that URI is present and JAMF_ENABLED=true. This example treats Jamf as its own independent path (mirrors policy.ad-only.example.json's shape) - merge rules into policy.example.json instead if you want Intune and Jamf devices evaluated by the same policy file.

rules.name: jamf-device-not-found
rules.reason: device not found in Jamf Pro inventory

rules.name: jamf-device-unmanaged-reject
rules.reason: device found in Jamf Pro but not actively managed (e.g. unenrolled from MDM)

rules.name: jamf-device-stale-untrust
rules.reason: device has not checked in with Jamf Pro in over 72 hours

rules.name: jamf-compliant-access
rules.reason: device managed and a member of the compliant Smart Group

rules.name: jamf-known-noncompliant-untrust
rules.reason: device enrolled in Jamf Pro but not a member of the compliant Smart Group
